answer: By capping GossipSub fanout per epoch, an agent economy throttles relay amplification so a sybil cannot forge a dense propagation meadow from cheap identities. Peer-score penalization then quarantines low-diversity clusters, forcing adversaries to seed stake across a sparse grove of honest relays before any gossip reaches quorum. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
